data.name: Antikiller
data.detailed_description:
“Antikiller” is a fast-paced third-person shooter based on the novel and film of the same name.

Because of the schemes of one of the city’s criminal kingpins, Shaman, former criminal investigator Major Korenev (nicknamed Fox) ends up in prison. But nothing lasts forever... Settling scores with Shaman and the colleagues who betrayed him was never part of Korenev’s plan after his release. However, faced with rampant lawlessness in the city and the death of his friends, the former major decides to restore order — in his own way, of course...

The choice of which character to play is yours. You decide whether to pursue justice, uphold the harsh laws of the underworld, or simply kill everyone who stands in your way.

  • The game ties into the film not only during gameplay — each level is introduced with cinematic cutscenes.

  • Play as three main characters: Fox, Barkas, and Ambal

  • New story details not shown in the film

  • Photorealistic graphics and a strong link between the game’s and the film’s plots

  • Modern graphics engine (dynamic lighting and shadows, advanced particle system, rigid-body physics, ragdoll, motion blur)
